scope: Original Rust/Ouroboros compact Lock configuration, one x64 GUI, two virtual mouse/keyboard pairs and two owned x64 probes; 320x360 and 360x360 logical client sizes. Individually scrolled responses, not simultaneous visibility of every field.

native.attachment: No routed input or probe attachment.

producer.checks: cargo fmt --all --check; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings; cargo test --workspace:410 passed,0 failed,3 ignored; x64+i686 app/observer builds PASS

accepted: Actual Movement bounds popup commits all five choices: Legacy, Desktop, Window, Monitor and Region. The fixed footer names the selected bounds Apply action.
Draft and acknowledged worker modes remain distinct: Region draft/Window applied before the single live Apply, then Region applied for A with B still Window.

Each stopped user chooses and stages its own exact owned window; both observed stages are cleared before live Start. Current, next-Start and highlighted candidate meanings remain distinct; transient HWND/token state is absent from profile.

Named target/candidate summaries and all four Region rows qualify whole response rectangles at320/360 through ordinary scrolling. Caption truncation uses Ouroboros font/tracking and visible width, with complete title/status hover; compact refresh keeps its accessible name.
Available and deliberately unavailable monitor paths are explicit. Reversed Region draft retains identity/other-user settings, visible validation and fully contained disabled Apply.

Existing MCP agent_session/routing_state inspection reports exact two users/two allowed PIDs and independent acknowledged modes. Optional session-control, capture and app-preferences grants remain false; these operations do not establish blanket input denial by policy.

Normal GUI Stop leaves no Controller, clean stopped recovery and no retained target; MCP EOF and owned WM_CLOSE exit normally. Independent review confirms all four original processes, known windows and private-image workers absent.
Opt-in sampling blocks next-step observation, scrolling and field/position edits until sample ACK; focused regression passes. No worker, backend, serialization or permission expansion.

failure_summary.001: Initial evidence only after runner handle finalization bug; separately recorded normal root cleanup. Initial zeros are not final execution evidence.

failure_summary.003: Runner sample/resize ordering; footer repair verified.

failure_summary.005: Actual candidate/chooser row width overflow after layout expansion.

limits: Virtual devices and explicitly owned targets only; hardware and RustDesk pointer untouched.
Scrolling is required; fourteen sampled originals and twenty-six full responses do not establish complete feature-page UX, accessibility or exact visual equivalence.

No monitor reconnect/mixed-DPI, native i686 execution, arbitrary application compatibility, performance benchmark, same-process/desktop-wide isolation, general P1 reliability or full Ultra parity claim.
Existing selection/startup/cursor/keyboard/dynamic-clamping families were not replayed for this layout group. MCP tools and grants are unchanged.
